Playwright MCP.notes: Richest tool surface (28 tools). browser_fill_form is uniquely powerful — batch fills. Stumbled on React Select dropdowns (not <select>). Warm browser = fast navigation (~2-3s). Snapshot format is token-efficient accessibility tree.

BrowserMCP.notes: Disconnected from Chrome mid-session — connection instability is itself a major reliability finding. Requires manual 'Connect' click on extension per tab. Only 12 tools (no evaluate, no file_upload, no network intercept). Unique value: authenticated pages (LinkedIn, internal tools). Scored based on documented capabilities + observed instability.

Lightpanda CLI.notes: Blazing fast (1.5-3s). Three dump modes: markdown, semantic_tree, semantic_tree_text. Fatal flaw: cannot render React/SPA pages (0 bytes on Ashby). Has MCP mode (`lightpanda mcp`) but requires Claude Code restart to configure. Best for high-volume scraping of traditional HTML pages.

Agent Browser CLI.notes: Full Chromium-backed CLI. Cold start is slow (~25-40s for first open). Ref format is bare ('e3' not '@ref=e3'). Upload inconsistency: works with CSS selectors but not refs. Snapshot format nearly identical to Playwright. No batch fill — one command per field. Good for scripted automation outside Claude Code.
